520:t_2:305.en:
$$シャア$$
「I won't let you lay a hand on $$ミネバ$$!」

520:t_2:306.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「$$アンジェロ$$! I leave that side to you!」

520:t_2:307.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Wake up already, $$フロンタル$$! That very $$アンジェロ$$ is proof that you are not the same as $$シャア$$!」

520:t_2:309.en:
$$アムロ$$
「You and $$シャア$$... $$アンジェロ$$ and $$ギュネイ$$... There is a big difference between them.」

520:t_2:310.en:
$$アムロ$$
「$$ギュネイ$$ chased after $$シャア$$'s back, in order to surpass him someday.」

520:t_2:311.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「To be defied even by his own protege... What a pitiful man.」

520:t_2:312.en:
$$アムロ$$
「That's not it. That is the result of $$シャア$$ showing $$ギュネイ$$ a future!」

520:t_2:314.en:
$$アムロ$$
「But, $$フロンタル$$! All you did was affirm $$アンジェロ$$!」

520:t_2:315.en:
$$アムロ$$
「You gave $$アンジェロ$$ the present, but that won't make him grow! He'll forever be a man who stays beneath you!」

520:t_2:316.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「What's wrong with that! I am prepared to dedicate everything to the Colonel!」

520:t_2:317.en:
$$シャア$$
「Admit it, $$アンジェロ$$! Without $$フロンタル$$, you can't do anything!」

520:t_2:318.en:
$$シャア$$
「You're nothing but a pet kept by $$フロンタル$$!」

520:t_2:319.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「Let you talk, and you...!」

520:t_2:320.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Humans took hold of the power called fire and built civilization. ...But the first human to touch fire must have trembled in fear at its heat...」

520:t_2:321.en:
$$アムロ$$
「When they overcame that, humanity gained evolution... a future!」

520:t_2:322.en:
$$アムロ$$
「You, who only maintain the status quo, can never go any further than this!」

520:t_2:324.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「I want every $$ネオ・ジオン$$ soldier here to listen to me.」

520:t_2:325.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「Whatever $$ラプラスの箱$$ may be, it will bring a great turning point to the way of $$ジオン$$. Humanity might even survive by $$フロンタル$$'s method.」

520:t_2:326.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「That is probably right. In the present situation, it may be the one and only realistic answer.」

520:t_2:327.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「But can that truly be called a future? Wasn't the future a word for a time different from now... a better world?」

520:t_2:328.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「There is none of the evolution and harmony of humanity that $$ジオン・ダイクン$$ dreamed of in that.」

520:t_2:330.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「As those who inherit the name of $$ジオン$$, as those who caused the horrors of the $$一年戦争$$, we bear a responsibility.」

520:t_2:331.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「We cannot fulfill that responsibility merely by accepting reality as it is.」

520:t_2:332.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「Is that coming from the last remnant of the $$ザビ家$$!」

520:t_2:333.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「Princess! I'll hold them off here! Fall back while you can!」

520:t_2:334.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「Stop, $$マリーダ$$! Come over here with the Princess!」

520:t_2:336.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「$$ジンネマン$$! Are you still bound to the past!」

520:t_2:338.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「Don't make $$マリーダ$$ suffer! Fulfill your own responsibility too!」

520:t_2:339.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「Remember, $$ジンネマン$$! From the moment you saved $$マリーダ$$, you...」

520:t_2:340.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「Reason... can't erase it, Princess... The grudge... the regret...」

520:t_2:341.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「I couldn't do... anything for them... They must have been scared... must have been in pain... and I did nothing... $$フィー$$... $$マリー$$...」

520:t_2:344.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「Will you... forgive my selfishness...?」

520:t_2:353.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「...I forgive you. This is my last order...」

520:t_2:360.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「$$ジンネマン$$, you bastard!」

520:t_2:361.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「Do it if you want to. I can't go on with you people anymore.」

520:t_2:362.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「You people are always like this! Irresponsible and weak!」

520:t_2:363.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「That's why we need power beyond humanity! The Colonel is one who has transcended humanity!」

520:t_2:366.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I won't let the Captain die!」

520:t_2:367.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「Gah! $$バナージ・リンクス$$!!」

520:t_2:368.en:
$$バナージ$$
「The future of humanity is... something humans create, isn't it!」

520:t_2:369.en:
$$バナージ$$
「People are weak and imperfect...! That's why they entrust it to others!」

520:t_2:370.en:
$$バナージ$$
「We keep walking on what's been entrusted to us! No matter how painful the road!」

520:t_2:371.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「The $$ユニコーン$$ has activated!?」

520:t_2:372.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Is the $$サイコ・フレーム$$ reacting to $$バナージ$$'s feelings!?」

520:t_2:373.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「We're falling back, $$アンジェロ$$.」

520:t_2:375.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Ngh! Damn you, $$シャア$$!」

520:t_2:376.en:
$$シャア$$
「So you hit back! Apparently you haven't completely become a vessel yet!」

520:t_2:377.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Are you provoking me, $$シャア$$!」

520:t_2:378.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Then I'll take you on! Board the $$サザビー$$!」

520:t_2:379.en:
$$シャア$$
「Fine! I'll settle my ties with you here and now!」

520:t_3:3.en: ～ Outer-Space Mothership $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$ Dock ～

520:t_3:5.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Forgive me for letting you see such an unsightly scene, Lady $$ミネバ$$.」

520:t_3:6.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「No... Right now you have a brighter expression than I have ever seen on you.」

520:t_3:8.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「I am the one who should thank you, $$ハマーン$$. I am grateful that you protected me until today and fought for $$ジオン$$... for the Spacenoids.」

520:t_3:9.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「But from now on, fight not for a cause or the house you were born into, but for what you yourself believe in.」

520:t_3:10.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「I am grateful, Lady $$ミネバ$$.」

520:t_3:11.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「That is probably the very place you should aim for as well.」
